records.title: About Bhupendra
records.answer: Bhupendra Singh Rathore is a senior UI/UX and product designer based in Indore, India. His published portfolio describes 9+ years across enterprise SaaS, consumer products, AI-powered experiences and brand systems. He combines user research, interface craft and close collaboration with product and engineering teams.
evidence: I’m Bhupendra Singh Rathore, a senior UI/UX and product designer based in Indore, India.

records.title: Professional experience
records.answer: His portfolio lists 9+ years in design. He is listed at Impetus Technologies as Assistant Manager, Design L1 / Senior Product Designer (Mar 2025–Present). Before that: Deqode Software Solutions (Apr 2021–Mar 2025), Orcomm Advertising (Apr 2018–Apr 2021) and Srijan Creative Cell (Jul 2016–Apr 2018). His work spans enterprise SaaS, AI, fintech, consumer journeys and brand systems.

records.title: Featured UX case study
records.answer: I recommend starting with Kyvos because it is the portfolio’s featured, detailed enterprise UX case study. It covers website UX, Semantic Layer communication, reusable design patterns, brand guidelines, campaigns and event experiences across 2025–2026. It also documents cross-functional leadership. The case study explicitly says conversion, engagement and CTR uplift have not been independently established.

records.title: Design leadership
records.answer: The clearest leadership example is Kyvos: Bhupendra describes aligning product, marketing, engineering, event teams and production vendors; translating briefs into design directions; coordinating reviews; resolving trade-offs; and maintaining quality through delivery. His About page also describes supporting junior designers with feedback at Deqode. TXT2Create adds an end-to-end product delivery example.

supported junior designers through feedback

records.answer: Ethos Self-Custody Vault is a self-custody crypto wallet experience, rather than an exchange. The page labels its outcome percentages as figures reported in the original case study, not independent measurements.

records.title: Alfred Copy Trading App
records.answer: Alfred is a decentralized copy-trading application. The portfolio describes simplifying navigation, onboarding and personalisation. Its page preserves conflicting reported retention percentages in their original context, so I would not present either figure as an independently verified result.
evidence: The Results text reports a 25% increase in retention, while the page’s headline metric displays 55%
